# PDE volume I — reproducible Taylor–Green 3D figures

The chapter `chapters/pl/partial_differential_equations/28-rownania-naviera-stokesa.tex`
references two PNG files in the `figures/` directory here.

- `taylor_green_3d_slices.png`: computed sections of the specified initial field
  `u0=(sin(x)cos(y)cos(z), -cos(x)sin(y)cos(z), 0)`; colors represent signed `omega_z`,
  **not** the magnitude of the full vorticity. Generated by `scripts/taylor_green_3d_plot.py`.
- `taylor_green_3d_schematic.png`: conceptual 3D illustration; deliberately not
  presented as numerically integrated trajectories. Generated by
  `scripts/taylor_green_3d_schematic.py`.

Rebuild with Python packages `numpy`, `scipy`, `matplotlib` and `plotly`:
```bash
python assets/pl/partial_differential_equations/scripts/taylor_green_3d_plot.py
python assets/pl/partial_differential_equations/scripts/taylor_green_3d_schematic.py
```
The first script also generates the optional interactive Plotly HTML file, omitted from Git
to avoid committing a megabyte-scale embedded Plotly bundle.

The book's main TeX preamble sets `\\graphicspath` to the repository asset directory.
When exporting selected chapters, the application generator should copy both referenced
PNG files and scripts into the generated project.
